=== .dwe/config ===
# .dwe/config — per-project DWE user overrides (gitignored, all-commented).
#
# This file pins per-developer preferences for THIS project without touching the
# global ~/.config/dwe/config. It is read by every `dwe` invocation run inside
# the project and is layered: global config < this file < environment variables.
#
# Syntax: flat `key = value` lines. Full-line `#` comments only (an inline `#`
# after a space is a parse error). Booleans accept 1/true/yes and 0/false/no.
# Unknown keys are warnings, not errors. Uncomment a line to activate it.
#
# Every key below is shown with its default. Run `dwe docs show config/userconfig`
# for the authoritative reference.

# --- Locale and TUI ---
# Preferred locale for translated strings. Unset → $LANG → en.
# language = en
# Mermaid theme for the `dwe docs` TUI: auto | dark | light. Default: auto.
# mermaid_theme = auto

# --- Binary overrides ---
# Absolute path DWE uses when invoking each external binary. Empty is rejected.
# binary_docker = docker
# binary_git    = git
# binary_dwe    = dwe
# binary_shell  = sh
# binary_mmdc   = mmdc

# --- Notifications ---
# Master gate for desktop notifications. Default: false.
# notify_enabled          = false
# Per-surface gates (only consulted when notify_enabled is true).
# notify_deploy_enabled   = true
# notify_run_enabled      = true
# notify_commands_enabled = true
# Comma-separated channel list (e.g. native).
# notify_channels         = native

=== AGENTS.md ===
# myproj — DWE project

This repository is a **DWE** (Dev Workspace Engine) project: a Docker-based local
development environment managed by the `dwe` CLI.

## Orientation for AI agents

Run this once to load a project-aware index of services, commands, and docs:

```
dwe docs llms-txt --lang en
```

It emits a compact llms.txt snapshot (project context, services, commands, and
pointers into the built-in docs subsystem) designed to be loaded once and then
navigated on demand.

## Conventions for AI agents

- **Docs in English.** Pass `--lang en` to every `dwe docs …` command (`llms-txt`,
  `show`, `search`, `list`) — translated docs can lag behind the English source.
- **Data as JSON.** For any command whose output you parse — `dwe status`,
  `dwe validate`, `dwe info`, `dwe services list`, `dwe commands list`,
  `dwe docs list`, `dwe docs search`, `dwe vars …` — add `--output json`
  (alias `-o json`); the default table output is formatted for humans.
  **Exception:** never pass `-o json` to `dwe docs llms-txt` or `dwe docs show`.
  Those emit markdown, and there `--output` is a *file path*, so `-o json` would
  write a file literally named `json`.

## Useful commands

Day-to-day work goes through the first two — they cover most of what an agent needs:

- `dwe commands list` — list this project's declared dev commands (tests, linters,
  migrations, …); `dwe cmd <id>` runs one, `dwe cmd -i <id>` shows its definition
  (type, service, workdir, the underlying command, its params)
- `dwe shell <service> -c '<cmd>'` — run a one-off command inside a service
  container, for anything not covered by a declared command

Inspecting the environment:

- `dwe` — project dashboard / header
- `dwe status` — stack health, per-service state and container names
- `dwe info` — environment summary (URLs, hosts, ports)
- `dwe logs [service]` — stream container logs
- `dwe validate` — static project-config validation

Lifecycle and reference:

- `dwe deploy run` — run the deploy pipeline (first-time provisioning, image
  builds, migrations); `dwe run` starts an already-provisioned stack
- `dwe docs show <topic> --lang en` — built-in reference (config schemas, guides);
  `dwe docs list --lang en` enumerates topics, `dwe docs search <substring> --lang en`
  searches them

## Config layout

- `workspace.yml` — project identity (name, prefix)
- `workspace/defaults.yml` — versioned defaults (service toggles, exports)
- `workspace/styles.yml` — CLI branding and palette
- `workspace/services/<name>/service.yml` — per-service definitions
- `workspace/{deploy,lifecycle,info,docker}.yml` — optional overrides. They ship
  fully commented; the built-in defaults stay active until you uncomment. An
  active override **replaces** the whole built-in pipeline, so edit them whole.

> `CLAUDE.md` is a symlink to this file (a copy on platforms without symlinks).
> Edit `AGENTS.md`.

--------
=== compose.yaml ===
# Base compose file for this DWE project.
#
# DWE merges this base with per-service compose overlays it generates from
# workspace/services/<name>/service.yml. Add project-wide compose configuration
# here (named volumes, networks, shared settings); per-service containers are
# managed by DWE and normally do not need a hand-written entry.
#
# Referenced from workspace/defaults.yml as `compose.base: compose.yaml`.

--------
=== workspace.yml ===
# workspace.yml — structural identity for this DWE project (layer 1 of 3).
#
# This is the only required project file. workspace/defaults.yml (layer 2) and
# workspace/local.yml (layer 3, gitignored) layer on top of it; keys absent here
# fall through to those layers. Run `dwe docs show config/workspace` for the full
# merge model.

project:
  name: "myproj"
  prefix: "dwe"

--------
=== workspace/defaults.yml ===
# workspace/defaults.yml — versioned project defaults (layer 2 of 3).
#
# Tracked by git. Everything here is overridable per-developer in
# workspace/local.yml (gitignored). Run `dwe docs show config/workspace`.

# Compose base file (always included by the Docker control plane).
compose:
  base: compose.yaml

# Service toggles. Service definitions live in
# workspace/services/<name>/service.yml; this overlay only flips enabled state
# (allowed keys per entry: enabled, ports, hosts).
services:
  "app":
    enabled: true

# runtime:
#   use_https: false
#   spx:
#     path: ""

# state: ""

# Declarative .env export rules. Each rule maps a dot-path in the merged config
# to an environment variable. See `dwe docs show config/workspace`.
# exports:
#   env:
#     - name: APP_PORT
#       from: services.<name>.ports.http
#       format: int

--------
=== workspace/deploy.yml ===
# workspace/deploy.yml — project deploy pipeline (INERT MIRROR).
#
# The built-in default deploy pipeline is ACTIVE. This file is shipped fully
# commented so the default keeps running untouched. Uncomment to override —
# doing so REPLACES the whole pipeline (composition is full-replacement, not a
# merge), so copy every phase you still want, then edit.
#
# Authoritative default: deploy.DefaultDeployConfig()
#   (internal/core/workflow/deploy/defaults.go)
# Schema and field reference: `dwe docs show config/deploy/index`
#
# log: true
# phases:
#   - name: services
#     description: "Deploy all enabled services (resolved by dependency order)"
#     deploy_services: true
#   - name: start
#     description: "Start containers and wait for health"
#     steps:
#       - name: up
#         type: dwe
#         cmd: "docker up --wait"
#         description: "Start all containers and wait until healthy"
#         untracked: true
#   - name: post-deploy
#     description: "Post-deploy summary (runs only if all prior phases succeeded)"
#     untracked: true
#     steps:
#       - name: info
#         type: dwe
#         cmd: "info"
#         description: "Show environment summary"
#       - name: success
#         type: builtin
#         cmd: message
#         with:
#           level: success
#           text: "Deploy completed successfully"

--------
=== workspace/docker.yml ===
# workspace/docker.yml — Docker Compose execution policy (INERT MIRROR).
#
# This file controls how `dwe docker` builds and runs `docker compose` commands
# (project name, per-subcommand args, process env). It is shipped fully
# commented; with no docker.yml the built-in policy applies. Uncomment to
# override — an active docker.yml replaces the built-in policy.
#
# Per-developer overrides go in workspace/docker.local.yml (gitignored), which
# is deep-merged on top of this file.
# Schema and field reference: `dwe docs show config/docker`
#
# project_name: "${project.prefix}-${project.name}"
#
# args:
#   global: ["--ansi", "always", "--progress", "tty"]
#   up: ["-d", "--remove-orphans"]
#   logs: ["-f"]
#   run: ["--rm"]
#   pull: []
#   build: []
#
# process_env:
#   DOCKER_CLI_HINTS: "false"

--------
=== workspace/info.yml ===
# workspace/info.yml — `dwe info` dashboard (INERT MIRROR).
#
# When this file is absent the built-in default dashboard is rendered. This file
# is shipped fully commented so that default stays active. Uncomment to take
# full control of the dashboard layout — an active info.yml replaces the
# built-in dashboard entirely.
#
# Authoritative behavior: the built-in `dwe info` fallback dashboard.
# Schema, item types, and template expressions: `dwe docs show config/info`
#
# sections:
#   - id: project
#     title: "Project"
#     items:
#       - type: definition
#         name: "Name"
#         value: "{{ .Project.Name }}"
#       - type: definition
#         name: "Prefix"
#         value: "{{ .Project.Prefix }}"
#   - id: urls
#     title: "URLs"
#     items:
#       - type: auto-urls
#   - id: hosts
#     title: "Hosts"
#     items:
#       - type: auto-hosts
#
# footer: true

=== workspace/lifecycle.yml ===
# workspace/lifecycle.yml — run / stop pipelines (INERT MIRROR).
#
# The built-in default run and stop pipelines are ACTIVE. This file is shipped
# fully commented so the defaults keep running untouched. Uncomment a section to
# override it — each section (run, stop) is full-replacement, not a merge, so
# copy every phase you still want, then edit. (The stop pipeline always has an
# auto-reap phase prepended by the engine regardless of what you author here.)
#
# Authoritative defaults: lifecycle.DefaultRunConfig() / DefaultStopConfig()
#   (internal/core/workflow/lifecycle/defaults.go)
# Schema and field reference: `dwe docs show config/lifecycle`
#
# run:
#   update:
#     mode: "off"
#   show_info: true
#   final_message: "Project is ready for work!"
#   phases:
#     - name: start
#       description: "Start containers and wait for health"
#       steps:
#         - name: up
#           type: dwe
#           cmd: "docker up --wait"
#           description: "Start all containers and wait until healthy"
#
# stop:
#   final_message: "Project is stopped. Have a nice day!"
#   phases:
#     - name: stop
#       description: "Stop containers"
#       steps:
#         - name: down
#           type: dwe
#           cmd: "docker down"
#           description: "Stop all containers"

=== workspace/services/app/service.yml ===
# workspace/services/app/service.yml — the "app" starter service.
#
# type + container are active; every other field is an optional, commented
# example. The folder name (app) is the service's map key — there is
# no `name:` field. Run `dwe docs show config/services/index`.

type: app
container: "app"

# required: true              # always-on; removes the enable/disable toggle
# dir: "./app"            # host source directory for this app
# depends_on: []
# ports:
#   http: 8080
# hosts:
#   web: "app.localhost"
# icon: "📦"
# render:
#   ide:
#     enabled: true

# workspace/styles.yml — CLI branding and semantic color palette.
